placements.why: The segment describes a system-level guarantee — id/slug generation with a deterministic fallback and successful commit — that is organizational-architecture grain, not envelope content. No strata category exists yet in this repo, and nothing in the empty graph structure covers 'how the pipeline processes input' as a category, so this founds it rather than being routed under something narrower.
placements.title: Pipeline mechanics as a first-class design surface
placements.frame: What must the pipeline itself guarantee about how it processes and normalizes input, independent of any single envelope's content?

placements.title: Slug identity survives absence through a fallback path, not a required field
placements.frame: When an envelope arrives without an explicit id, does the pipeline still resolve a stable slug — via LLM id-gen or deterministic fallback — and commit successfully, or does the absence break the pipeline?
placements.why: The expression names a recurring pipeline behavior — producing a slug from content when no id is submitted, via either an LLM call or a deterministic fallback, then committing — that future envelopes testing this same robustness would keep feeding. This is a subject beyond the one test instance (grain test passes), distinct from the strata-level claim that pipeline mechanics matter at all, so it sits under Architecture as its own leaf rather than folding into the strata node.
